question: A vibration magnetometer has a time period $T$ in the Earth's horizontal magnetic field $B_H$. A short bar magnet is placed north of the magnetometer with its North Pole pointing South. The magnetometer is on the axial line of the short magnet. The time period of oscillation decreases to $T/\sqrt{3}$. What is the magnitude of the magnetic field due to the short magnet ($B_{ext}$) at the position of the magnetometer?
